name: SpeakEasy
tagline: Upload a short talk and get graded feedback with reference talks chosen for your topic.
problem: Speakers get little specific feedback on their talks.
solution: Transcribes the talk, grades clarity, structure, vocabulary, grammar and rhetoric with Gemini, and pulls short reference talks on the same topic for comparison.
demo_moment: Team-described: upload a ramble and read the scored breakdown.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “VTHacks - Best First Time Hack” among 112 submissions.
A first-time team that built a full audio and text pipeline.
